tasks.short: Support prescribed exercise and mobility aids

steps.what: Read the patient's actual prescribed exercise or brace-use instructions and current care-plan limits
inputs: existing prescribed exercise or aid instructions

steps.what: Direct the patient in the simple prescribed exercises or actual brace or artificial-limb use with responsive hands-on support
outputs: actual prescribed exercise or aid-use support

steps.what: Write and save the actual care entry on prescribed exercise or aid-use support and observed difficulties
inputs: actual prescribed exercise or aid-use support

tasks.design: Link the actual prescribed instructions in the care record {OTHER} and {DOCS}; reuse only the existing care-entry headings. Keep all patient interaction, physical assistance and actual observation capture human, without changing the prescription or generating exercise advice.
tasks.previous_blocker: Current prescribed instructions can require repeated retrieval and care notes repeat visit identifiers.
tasks.enabler_now: Native care-plan links and existing entry fields can remove those small repeated operations.
tasks.still_hard: Actual patient response, mobility aids and the limits of the prescription require direct attention and nursing direction.
tasks.human_edge: The aide notices difficulty, responds within the prescribed instructions and seeks appropriate professional support when needed.

ambition.what: Prescribed exercise and mobility-aid support remain direct care.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native care-plan links and visit fields can reduce navigation and repeated headers without replacing prescribed exercise support or changing care instructions.

assumptions: {OTHER} means the existing home-care clinical record and the patient's physical mobility aids. Boundary includes prescribed-instruction reading, actual support and the care entry already used by nursing staff; no additional exercise report or recording is invented.

The actual prescribing professional/care team supplies patient ID, current prescription/version, aid reference and stated support limits through existing work. s1 counts substantive reading, currency checks and manual fallback; s2 produces actual support and observations, and s3 retains their manual capture and complete meaning checks. No free new structured response data is assumed.

Test native links and care-entry fields first. s1 removes2 of10 repeated navigation units, retaining8 for reading. s3 removes only1 of10 repeated patient/visit-heading units, retaining9 for actual observations and difficulties. Ordinary same-system save stays within retained writing at near-zero time, ungated and with no saving.

All80 direct-care units stay; no model, treatment choice, external send or formal prescription change is proposed. The estimates are unmeasured. Link/field repair beyond actual care checks is additional upkeep below.
unknowns: Current care-plan links and note fields
Actual visit entry read by nursing staff
Access and current prescribed support route
research_questions: Observe real instruction lookup, hands-on support and the actual care entry separately.
Test a changed prescription reference and an unexpected patient difficulty without generating new exercise advice.

already_counted.description: Prescribed-source reading, all direct patient support and actual care-entry capture/checking remain in s1-s3.

incremental.description: Maintain prescription reference links and existing care-entry fields and repair changed references beyond normal care reading.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=8+80+9=97. Gross3 less1 upkeep gives2. Conservative case: unfamiliar brace instructions retain9 of10 lookup units and unusual response needs all10 note units. One gross unit only covers upkeep; direct care is unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The aide keeps direct prescribed care and observation responsibility; native reference and note fields offer only a small reduction in repeated record work.
skills_to_grow: Record actual response and uncertainty clearly
Distinguish care-note persistence from a changed care order
role.ambitious_version: Keep actual prescribed support and patient observations clear to the supervising care team without introducing automated clinical advice.
